exact_missing_items: Provider_OpenCode.md never explains how PM obtains upstream account identity from behind the server bridge
OpenCode and other bridged runtimes may switch or obscure upstream accounts behind the bridge; the docs currently do not say whether this is capturable, opaque-but-accepted, or a hard gap

Provider_OpenCode.md still leaves effective account identity opaque behind the bridge, uses a server-global SSE bus with no explicit contamination filter contract, and relies on a fixed server working directory
Permissions_System.md still scopes always approvals and reject-cascades to the whole session, which is unsafe for multi-lane/multi-actor execution
permission snapshots still have no account-switch invalidation rule even though account changes can affect effective tool availability
bridged-provider usage events still omit effective account and pressure/switch fields
no lane/package/worktree identity enters the bridged envelope where Source Control / Orchestrator handshake now needs it

Add capability declarations for bridged providers to CLI_Bridged_Providers.md (matching language of direct providers): CAPABILITY_MULTI_ACCOUNT, CAPABILITY_SWITCH_NOTIFICATION, CAPABILITY_LANE_ATTRIBUTION, etc.
Bridge envelope must carry effective account identity and switch-reason when capabilities are declared
Permission reject-cascade and session-cache scope must be limited to actor/lane-aware boundaries, not whole session
gap_candidates.blocking_reason: Coverage row indicates incomplete or missing canon alignment for concrete target.
